difficulty_reason: The selected obligation requires the complete new maximal-separator uncrossing and modular-order argument that forces a strict pairwise imbalance between distinct tangle separators. Even after the precise ordinary Tucker theorem, the proof must encode those separator imbalances into a sym/skew matrix, translate its vector into vertex weights and handle the exceptional singleton-support case without losing the other strict orientations. This simultaneous combinatorial weight construction remains a nonroutine advanced obligation of the main graph result, rather than a routine helper or a direct invocation of linear-programming duality.
